text:
Situation: Promethazine hydrochloride injection shortage has been listed by FDA as Current since 2023-11-21 and remains Current as of 2026-10-21. The shortage covers Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. and XGen Pharmaceuticals DJB, Inc. injection presentations. Our tablet inventory at Corvale General (PD-Rx Pharmaceuticals, Inc. NDC 43063040505 and Zydus Lifesciences Limited NDC 65841004110) is not on the shortage list.

Why (FDA record): FDA first posted the shortage on 2023-11-21. The Zydus Lifesciences Limited plant (FEI 3002984011) received OAI classifications after inspections ending 2014-09-05 and 2019-05-03; the 2019 OAI letter is dated 2019-11-14, 1,468 days before the shortage posting. The PD-Rx Pharmaceuticals, Inc. plant (FEI 1641825) shows only VAI inspections, most recently ending 2026-08-20.

Our position: Tablet supply at Corvale General is adequate (23 days on hand). Corvale Lakeside has 9.6 days on hand. Corvale East has 12.3 days. No tablet shortage exists for our labeled products.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 9 tablets of 25 mg from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Monitor FDA shortage list for any tablet presentation additions — approved by buyer.

Not recommended: Purchasing from Actavis Pharma, Inc., Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC, Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC, or Amneal Pharmaceuticals of New York LLC at this time; none appear on the FDA shortage list and their labels name no identifiable plant for quality assessment.
